sourceCopy.name: Calories Burned Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Calories Burned Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Estimate exercise calories from your weight, activity and workout time. Free MET-based calculator with no sign-up; results are estimates.
sourceCopy.intro: Choose an activity, enter your body weight and workout duration, and see an estimate based on published MET values. Compare gross calories with active calories above resting energy.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How does this calories burned calculator work?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: It estimates gross calories as MET × weight in kilograms × minutes ÷ 60, using the conventional approximation of 1 kcal/kg/hour for 1 MET. The activity values are examples from the 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities. A MET estimate is not a measurement of your personal calorie use.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Are my weight and activity uploaded?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The estimate runs in your browser. Your inputs are not uploaded or saved by this tool.
howTo: Choose the activity that most closely matches your effort, or enter a custom MET value.
Enter body weight and whole workout minutes. Pounds convert to kilograms for the equation.
Compare gross calories with active calories. Both are estimates, not a fitness-device reading.

additionalFaqs.question: What is the difference between gross and active calories?
additionalFaqs.answer: Gross calories include the conventional resting-energy amount for the workout time. Active calories subtract that 1-MET reference. Neither is an individualized measurement.

additionalFaqs.question: Why can this estimate differ from my watch?
additionalFaqs.answer: MET values describe population-level activity intensity. Personal effort, fitness, body composition, terrain and measurement method can change actual energy use.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I use this to plan weight loss or decide how much to eat?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. The estimate is not a diet, weight-loss or medical recommendation. Do not use it to set food intake or replace advice from a qualified health professional.

fields.customMetHint: Enter a value from 1 to 20. Use a published MET source when possible.
fields.activityHint: Choose the closest listed effort. MET values are reference averages, not personal measurements.
fields.accuracyNote: Estimate only for adults. Actual energy use varies by person and conditions. Do not use this result as medical, nutrition or weight-loss advice.
fields.sourceNote: MET values listed here are drawn from the 2024 Adult Compendium. The standard 1-MET convention is an approximation and can differ from an individual’s resting metabolism.
